Site Reliability Engineering

Escalonamento de serviço

A formal process in IT operations and incident management by which unresolved service issues or incidents are elevated to higher support tiers, subject-matter experts, or management levels according to escalation policy.

Quick answer: A formal process in IT operations and incident management by which unresolved service issues or incidents are elevated to higher support tiers, subject-matter experts, or management levels according to escalation policy.

Questions and answers

What is Escalonamento de serviço?

In this glossary, Escalonamento de serviço refers to: A formal process in IT operations and incident management by which unresolved service issues or incidents are elevated to higher support tiers, subject-matter experts, or management levels according to escalation policy.

How is Escalonamento de serviço used in IT and DevOps?

In IT and DevOps communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Se um incidente crítico não puder ser resolvido dentro do prazo do SLA, o escalonamento de serviço é acionado para garantir a intervenção de especialistas."

Definition

A formal process in IT operations and incident management by which unresolved service issues or incidents are elevated to higher support tiers, subject-matter experts, or management levels according to escalation policy.

Operational example

If a critical incident cannot be resolved within the SLA window, service escalation is triggered to ensure expert intervention.

Localized term
